prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: full-screen illustrated portrait casual mobile puzzle game background, 720:1520 aspect. Background artwork only.
Primary request: Create 敦煌流金 as a SUNLIT DESERT OASIS AND ANCIENT SANDSTONE GROTTO, radically unlike an interior room or a framed curtain backdrop.
Scene and composition: In the upper-left a monumental eroded sandstone arch sweeps diagonally overhead, asymmetric and cropped, its ochre stone rich with weathered shallow lotus/geometric carving fragments at only the top-left corner. Through this great arch the view opens into a tiny turquoise oasis and distant rolling dunes under pale turquoise desert sky, sunlit depth receding across the upper third. A few oasis palm silhouettes stay far away and tiny. Far upper-right only a tiny fragment of turquoise-and-ochre mural pattern on a rock face, no full symmetric border.
The main central and lower area is a broad pale sunlit SANDY STONE PLINTH/ground extending toward the viewer in gentle perspective, starting about y30% and going to the bottom. It is clear and uncluttered, nearly cream sandstone with subtle sandy mineral grain and softly worn undulations. Strong warm sunlight enters diagonally from upper right, casting an elegant soft-edged arch shadow toward far left while keeping the central card area light and low contrast. Lower foreground edge contains a bit of terracotta carved stone with a single small weathered BRASS vessel tucked in the far lower-left corner. No hotpot, no wood or table.
Color and rendering: vivid but tasteful desert amber/orange sandstone against turquoise sky/oasis, luminous gold sunlight, richly tactile carved sandstone, dusty mineral pigments. Painterly detailed casual mobile game illustration with atmospheric distance, confident brush finish and inviting warm mood. Landscape and geology must dominate, no fabrics.
Functional composition for later game overlay, do not render UI: central tiles will occupy x21–75%, y34–57%, which must remain on the spacious pale stone resting plane with no rocks, pots, carvings or strong shadow edges. Top logo y0–10%, levelbar y10–15%, tray y74–82%, buttons y91–96%. Leave the lower central surface unobstructed.
STRICT NEGATIVES: no humans, statues of people, figures, letters, Chinese characters, words, text, logos, watermarks, numbers, UI, food tile cards, buttons, trays, menus, phone frame. No fabric curtains/swags, no room, no twin lamps, no symmetrical arch frame, no twin vases/pedestals. No copper hotpot. No brown wooden tabletop. No blank rectangular rice-paper center. Show unmistakable desert oasis, sandstone arch and luminous pale stone foreground.
